item.title: Government bans jigsaws
item.description: Journalists have noticed a new measure that didn’t make it into Rachel Reeve’s Spring Statement speech today. In the small print of the accompanying documents, that only the accountants and tax lawyers read, there is a dramatic new initiative to ban jigsaws. Jigsaws – basically cut up pictures that you have to reassemble – will be banned for everyone between 16 and state pension age, which currently 66 - at least for a few more weeks.
